SEBoK Defense Acquisition System, Distilled

Fifth-batch SEBoK distillation, batch 5/5 doc 2. Editorial state: 404 against the prompt-named URL; reading proceeds against composite carriers per Doc 583 amendment — DoD 5000.02 (the load-bearing external carrier), the Part 7 defense-system cluster (Submarine Warfare Federated Tactical Systems, Virginia Class Submarine, Miniature Seeker Technology Integration Spacecraft), and HSI's defense-aerospace institutional ground (SE-038). Defense Acquisition System is a Cluster E D8.1 external-carrier instance: the discipline's substantive articulation lives in DoD 5000.02 + DAU + JCIDS rather than at any SEBoK page. The Cluster B three-scale sub-form (Doc 604 §XII, formalization-ready per §VII.7) reads decisively at three nested scales: program-of-record (intra-program SE-PM-DA-PMO four-keeper composition), portfolio (DoD component → service → joint at JCIDS), federated (joint capability portfolios across services). The acquisition-system surface is the canonical three-scale Cluster B test: each scale exhibits multi-keeper composition with a distinct reconciliation rung, and the three scales are nested rather than parallel — the canonical formal worked example Doc 604 §XII has been awaiting. Six clusters compose; three-scale Cluster B + DoD 5000 stress-tests both pass.

II. Source Read

The standalone Defense Acquisition System page does not exist. The discipline lives substantively at DoD 5000.02 (with companion JCIDS, PPBE, DAU curriculum) — the canonical external carrier. Within SEBoK, the discipline's traces appear distributively across the Part 7 defense case-study cluster and across HSI's institutional-ground citation set (US Army AR 602-2, US Navy Opnav, MIL-STD-46855, etc.). DoD 5000.02 articulates the acquisition life-cycle with milestones (A, B, C), phases (Materiel Solution Analysis, Technology Maturation and Risk Reduction, Engineering and Manufacturing Development, Production and Deployment, Operations and Support), and adaptive acquisition pathways (Major Capability, Middle Tier, Software, Urgent, Defense Business Systems, Acquisition of Services). Three nested scales operate: program-of-record (PMO + SE + DA + PEO at single-program rung), portfolio (Service component portfolios under DoD components), federated (Joint Capability Areas across services and combatant commands).

III. Structural Read

Cluster E D8.1 (external-carrier sub-pattern, SE-039 §VII.6 / §VII.7). Defense Acquisition is a canonical D8.1 instance — formalization migrates outside SEBoK to DoD 5000.02 + JCIDS + DAU. SEBoK's surface carries pointer-content and case-study traces; the discipline's authoritative articulation lives at the DoD institutional carrier. Joins SE-126 (Design-to-Cost, INCOSE Handbook + DoD 5000.02 carrier) and SE-139 (Open SE, standards-body ecosystem) as the third confirmed D8.1 instance; the sub-pattern is firmly load-bearing.

Cluster B three-scale sub-form (Doc 604 §XII, formalization-ready per §VII.7), canonical worked example. Defense Acquisition reads decisively at three nested scales:

  • Program-of-record — PMO-keeper, SE-keeper, DA-keeper, contractor-keepers compose at single-program rung; reconciliation rung is the program baseline; rule is coordination-by-rung with PMO as integrator (intra-organization, paralleling HSI's eight-keeper density).
  • Portfolio — service-component portfolios under DoD components; reconciliation rung is the service POM/PPBE cycle; rule is negotiation-by-priority across programs (inter-organization-joint, paralleling supply-chain and logistics scale).
  • Federated — Joint Capability Areas across services and combatant commands; reconciliation rung is the JROC and JCIDS process; rule is negotiation-by-priority across services (federated, paralleling SoS scale).

The three scales are nested rather than parallel — programs compose into service portfolios compose into joint capability portfolios. Defense Acquisition is the canonical three-scale Cluster B worked example Doc 604 §XII has awaited. The third-rung scale (federated) is structurally identical to SE-071's SoS readings.

DoD 5000 stress-test passes. The DoD 5000.02 milestone-and-phase structure reads as Cluster I temporal-concurrency lattice (Doc 572 Appendix C) at the acquisition rung — the Materiel Solution Analysis, TMRR, EMD, Production, O&S phases operate concurrently across portfolio elements while individual programs traverse sequentially. The adaptive acquisition pathways are universal-sibling lattice (Cluster A) at the pathway rung: Major Capability, Middle Tier, Software, Urgent, DBS, Services partition the acquisition surface as peer-axes binding each program engagement aspect-wise.

Cluster F forward-pulverization (Doc 445 Refinement C). Each milestone gate is a forward-pulverization rung: the program premortems against future risk before passing the gate. Milestone B (start of EMD) is the canonical forward-pulverization instance.

Cluster K (V3 / virtue constraints, Doc 314). DoD 5000.02's Earned Value Management and program-baseline-discipline are V3-as-procedure-binding: the procedure exists because virtue is structurally insufficient at acquisition stakes (per SE-108 strongest-form articulation). Adds an acquisition-rung V3 instance to Cluster K's saturated surface.

Cluster G (SIPE, Doc 541). Acquisition-program coherence emerges at and above a coherence-density threshold composed of SE discipline + PM discipline + contractor compliance + funding stability + requirements stability. Sub-threshold programs spiral (FBI VCF analog at defense scale); supra-threshold programs deliver. The defense-acquisition rung supplies a saturated SIPE instance.

V. Residuals

Three-scale Cluster B canonical worked example earned. Doc 604 §XII formalization-ready since §VII.7; Defense Acquisition supplies the densest and most structurally explicit worked example yet — three scales nested with named reconciliation rungs at each. Cluster B synthesis successor should treat Defense Acquisition as the §XII anchor.

D8.1 third confirmed instance. Three-instance threshold reached for D8.1 (SE-126, SE-139, SE-193). Sub-pattern promotion to first-class structural form is now warranted in the next refinement round.

Editorial absence read as substance. Defense Acquisition is too institutionally-load-bearing for SEBoK to host directly; the formalization rung lives at DoD 5000.02. SEBoK's editorial choice respects the Cluster E carrier-of-record; the reading is correct on both sides.
